target_customer: Global consumers and B2B buyers of home and kitchen products
problem: Indian manufacturers lack a design-led brand and distribution to sell home goods globally.
business_model: Direct to consumer, marketplace and B2B wholesale of own brand home products

founders.name: Deepak Garg
founders.background_notes: As described on the YC page.

founders.name: Harris Cheng
founders.background_notes: Employers not named on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Mostly supply chain and brand operations with an ERP and design tooling.

defensibility.rationale: Consumer home goods are easily copied; advantage rests on sourcing.

market_need_then: Company cites an $800B home and kitchen market and demand for cross border goods made in India.

brand_strength.rationale: Name confusable with Warp and WarpBuild; no brand evidence.

outcome_analysis: Warpfy pitched a Shein of home model for India made home goods and now runs The Fine Living Company and an India wholesale platform, with company reported 300 plus products. Public information is thin, funding aside from a reported $125K pre-seed in aggregators is unknown, and no outcome event was found.
notes: Funding of $125K pre-seed (aggregators, East Ventures, MM Venture Partners, Trajectory) unverified. Co-founder Tarini Pancholi appears only in aggregator results so not listed. No dated competitor source found. YC page says team size 3 and location Singapore.
